notes.title: Early Access Update - 0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
In this update I have finally added cars to the game. For now there are 2 types of cars. More cars will come at 1.0 release. Cars can be used to break building to push objects when activated by a device.

Cars can be found under Normal Props -> Cars button on the bottom inventory panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/a393fb977b814783afc495920bf17f808623307f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/3190b1493e809f1f21faaaa262aa53207d416a94.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/fcd7ec347d130ccaff88213f074f6d3d258d112b.jpg[/img]

Finally i want to announce that we are close to version 1.0. So from now on the updates will be on the Experimental branch, which will be pushed to the Main Branch at 1.0 release. The reason for this change is to make some drastic changes to the Physics calculations without hampering the main game in between. If all my calculations are correct then 1.0 release is going to be soon within a few months. 

Thanks you all for staying with me the whole time.

Let me know if you are facing any errors. Please don't hesitate to share any ideas if you have any. 

Discord Server Link - https://discord.com/invite/aBmPSBKT8C

Thanks,
Agniv

notes.title: Update - 0.7 (Ragdolls Added)
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year in advance.

I finally present you the Ragdolls update which was requested a few months back. 

After working on the  performance stability of ragdolls has been quite satisfactory, so you can have quite a number of ragdolls on screen even on lowest settings. 

However sometimes the ragdolls may get stuck with the mesh. (this may happen on highest collision settings with a dated pc, modern pcs should handle this quite better) This cannot be avoided as the Physics system has to calculate all those collisions and some collisions will overlap for some milliseconds.

For now we are adding [b]3 Ragdolls.[/b] In the 1.0 release there will be more.
[list]
[*] Santa Claus
[*] Clown
[*] Skeleton
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/44eb1cae8150314430dfe71069fe7c4658e73b5e.jpg[/img]

Ragolls Enabled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/3b32587c4921d1ca6d26c6ddeae044a4b556c548.jpg[/img]

The ragdolls have [b]5 different animations [/b]that they will keep on playing during simulation until they get hit or they fall from some height. They can be changed via the properties panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/8d41973556e55dd73b5706b7732653603896b8a4.png[/img]

[b]Connection Visibility Toggle Button[/b] : -  Added a button to show or hide the connections visibility as requested. In this way the scene will be less cluttered visually with all the connections lines. The button can be accessed from the top panel.

[b]Bugs Fixed:-[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Fireworks tooltips.
[*] Fixed typos in some tooltips.
[*] Control buttons are being changed dynamically in the shortcut panel without the need to restart the game.
[/list]


We are closing to Full Release 1.0. Cant wait for that date. Thank you all for the support.

Discord Server Link - https://discord.com/invite/aBmPSBKT8C

Thanks,
Agniv
Gamergetik

notes.content:

[b]Here are the most important feature updates:-[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Night Mode -[/b] Finally the long awaited Night Mode is here. You can create your own levels with both day and night settings. To Enable Day / Night Mode simply go to [b]World Settings panel --> Time of Day[/b] settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/a9d9f3262269a9b8732cacf6c4a7e97fa6053db0.png[/img]

[*] [b]Fireworks[/b] - Also Fireworks are here. For starters i have added 5 type of fireworks. To enable fireworks you have to go to the fireworks tab and select them. They work like Connectible devices. So the process is same like that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/6088a4f0946c8eeb601e04ac3755ec1c29894f12.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/2d165ca16d04ca674e580fcf118c5f1bd60fd06e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/271f8152330128b8aad75a2474009be3ac86a3dc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936587/39278e2aa9b0d65fab607dfc3957b98c59c7c33b.png[/img]

[*] Added a key binding for shortcut - [b]Add To Selection[/b].
[*] Shortcut key changes are now updated automatically in the All Controls panel without  needing to restart the game.

[*] Discord server link has been added in game.

Now that a lot of the major change is done in the codebase the updates will be more frequent. Thanks for the patience.

Let us know if you are facing any errors.

notes.title: Workshop Bug Fixes (Update 0.1.5.1)
notes.content:
Hello,

After releasing the Workshop update we found out some minor bugs. So this update will address those bugs.

The list of fixes include the following :-
[list]

[*] Fixed : Workshop preview image not updating when the file is updated.
[*] Fixed : Workshop title and description not updating on updating the file.
[/list]

Following are the Design Choices Which are not bugs :-

[list]
[*] Since Steam has a size limitation of having 1-2mb preview images, the preview image may not always be high quality. In that case you are free to add any custom image through the steam workshop page. We cant do anything in this case since if we raise the image size then the file will not be uploaded. So we suggest you to first update the file on workshop , then use the steam workshop page to upload custom images for workshop display. (However this would only be seen while browsing workshop.)

[*] When the game is first loaded the downloaded levels will be empty from the load panel. In that case simply use the refresh button to refresh the levels. (provided steam has a internet connection). This is done to avoid duplication of downloaded files. This is again not a bug. Also you have to refresh the page a couple of times depending on your network. Just wait a few minutes before retrying.

[/list]

Thanks for the support.
Team Gamergetik

notes.title: When Is The Next Update Coming ?
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Its been almost 3 weeks since last update. So the real question is why we are not updating each week as planned previously. Let us give you the reason. 

We are working on the following features :-
[olist]
[*] New Map
[*] Workshop Support
[*] Campaign Mode
[*] A separate dedicated tutorial scene (Instead of showing tutorial in game now)
[*] Localization
[*] Achievements
[*] Props such as Ragdolls (Requested) and others.
[/olist]

Now the problem is that , all of this are related to one another. Like we already implemented Workshop support, Added a campaign mode and a separate tutorial scene. We also made some progress with the achievements system. The new map is also being added to the game. 

So as you can see a lot of things are being added to the game simultaneously. This is why it is hard to separate it out in each week update. Instead we are taking the time to implement everything first. After that we will do a beta test and then release them one by one.

This is the reason why we are not doing weekly updates. Its not that we have abandoned our game. So chill guys. The next update that is now on advanced stages of testing is the Workshop support which should be out soon. 

Game development is not easy and the most hard part is to release updates which doesn't ruin the player experience. That is what we are doing now. I Hope you are going to stay with us.

In the meantime you can definitely contact us about any bugs you encountered, give us suggestions and ideas. We will definitely fix them as we did with the previous bugs. Our Discord and Discussions channel is always open. We respond most of the time within 24hours.

Thanks,
Team Gamergetik.

notes.title: Roadmap & Future Updates
notes.content:
Hello,

Hope you are all having a blast with the game. Thank you for giving us so much love and support.

In this post We are going to give you a overview of the main features that will be added to the game during the period of Early Access. The list I am about to show you contains a top view of the features that the game will surely have on release. 

Details of more features and other additions that we will do after feedbacks will be announced as we release a update. 

Here is the overview of the features that will be added :- 

[list]
[*]Steam Cloud (Already Implemented in 0.1.3)
[*]Campaign Mode.
[*]Achievements.
[*]Workshop Support.
[*]More Props (including Automobiles, Ships, etc. and some secret props which needs to be unlocked by the player.)
[*]New Maps. (Desert, Medieval and many more.)
[*]Localization.
[*]Quality of Life Updates. (Includes different settings and utilities to make the game easier)
[*]Bug Fixes.
[/list]

Details of all the new props that are added will be under the Updated Discussions on Steam forums. So if you want to know the current progress of the updates make sure to Follow Roadmap thread on the Steam Discussions.

The above features will surely be present in the game at Release v1.0 when the game will come out of Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1331180/Destructive_Contraptions/

Keep in mind updates will continue even after Early Access since we are sure our community will keep giving us new prop ideas. We will continue to add them to the game as long as it can be supported.

If you have any new ideas and suggestions that you want to see in this game please let us know. :)

If you want to follow along and see how the game progresses follow us here :- 

[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/25dfKRj3Kr]Discord [/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDfya8Dq5ib2fSnk_3AMyGg]You Tube[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/gamergetik]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

Hoping to see your creations. All the best.

Regards,
Team Gamergetik.
